Greetings! 👾

I am a machine learning researcher, broadly interested in solving the most impactful challenges in machine learning, computer vision, genetics, healthcare and longevity!

I am currently a Member of Technical Staff (Intern) at Ideogram, training text-to-image models from scratch on the Core Machine Learning Research team. I am also completing a Computer Science Specialist and Molecular Genetics Major at the University of Toronto (Trinity College; expected April 2027), and I have previously worked at the Vector Institute, Amazon Web Services RDS, and the University Health Network.
